description.value:
A genius among smartguns. Rumored to be a Kang Tao prototype.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 45 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Autoloader, Smart Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4) • Mods: None

Special Features: All ammunition fired by this weapon also applies the effect of EMP Ammunition on top of their usual damage or other effects. If damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, the user can choose to leave their target Unconscious at 1 HP instead. As an Action, this weapon can be folded/unfolded. While folded, this weapon is concealable but cannot fire. Incompatible with Folding Structure.

While this weapon’s magazine is empty, the user may expend their Move Action to Reload it without an Action [Autoloader]. The Autoloader is then considered empty, and cannot be used again until until an Action is used to reset it.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Autoloader, Smart Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
